notes.title: Armada Pet Wars Patch 0.31.624.04
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/eff19296b7e8f0fa73cbb913996f74a0a26a4588.png"]     Patch 0.31.624.04

BUG - auto update not updating to two levels on a component if the first is not researched

setup more game resolutions, restrict invalid ones for display being used
There are now 324 potential resolution combinations, but to simplify and avoid screen errors, I have the current display scanned for its max width and height to only offer resolutions on those boundaries.  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/23f5c4adcf96b765cd767fb76067376a6dd9d23d.png"]
move local options out of game options
This is in preparation for my deeper dive into figuring out cloud saves with Steam. My first attempt was a fail, but hopefully by separating screen size and sounds from game options this will work better for people playing APW on a PC and on a Steamdeck.


change market orders, remove 5 orders and add 10000 instead
During testing I'm noticing that large orders are common, this allows for 10000 units at a time to be transacted with one button push.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/f9c728d22b15bf5f3547174b8f047d2e361e7bed.png"]

notes.title: Armada Pet Wars Patch 0.31.61602
notes.content:
Patch 0.31.61602
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/eff19296b7e8f0fa73cbb913996f74a0a26a4588.png"]
change fullscreen to windowed fullscreen
fullscreen has now been modified to windowless, which works better based on initial testing.


show fleets that don't have all ships assigned for tactics if tactics are available
fleet icons now will pulse if there are ships that need to be placed in the tactics screen to remind the player.


make adding ships to ship tactics auto select left-most ship
fleet tactics are a little faster to implement.
